parse.title: mejorar
parse.text:
Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Late Latin meliōrāre, a verb based on Latin melior (“better”). By surface analysis, mejor +‎ -ar. Compare English ameliorate.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /mexoˈɾaɾ/ [me.xoˈɾaɾ]
  • Audio (Colombia); [me.hoˈɾaɾ]:(file)
  • Rhymes: -aɾ
  • Syllabification: me‧jo‧rar

Verb

[edit]

mejorar (first-person singular present mejoro, first-person singular preterite mejoré, past participle mejorado)

  1. to make better, improve
  2. to enhance
  3. to ameliorate
  4. (reflexive) to improve; get better; get well
